spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is the bridge and river for this scene; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Morning on the cable-stayed bridge from image 3. Two city buses pass each other side by side in opposite lanes, filling the frame from the side. In the left bus the woman sits at a window seat; in the right bus, framed by its own window just a short gap away, the man sits at a window seat. They turn and catch each other's eyes through the two layers of bus glass. Both of them are clearly INSIDE their buses, seated, seen through the windows. The bridge pylon, cables and the wide river are visible above and behind the buses. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
